-- Phase 1: spec only. Bodies are `unreachable` until phase 2.

-- True when `path` is relative and never climbs out of its directory.
-- Absolute paths and any `..` that reaches above the start are rejected.
is_inside(path: str) -> bool =
  ex is_inside("a.txt") == True
  ex is_inside("sub/../a.txt") == True
  ex is_inside("..") == False
  ex is_inside("/etc/passwd") == False
  ex is_inside("sub/../../x") == False
  if path == ""
    return False
  let parts = path.split("/")
  if parts[0] == ""
    return False
  var depth = 0
  for p in parts
    if p == ".."
      depth -= 1
      if depth < 0
        return False
    if p != ".." and p != "." and p != ""
      depth += 1
  depth >= 0

-- Text of the file `path` inside `notes`, or "" when the path leaves `notes`
-- or the file is missing or unreadable. Reads only through the `notes` view of fs.
read_public(path: str) -> str uses fs =
  post is_inside(path) or out == ""
  ex read_public("../secret.txt") == ""
  ex read_public("/etc/passwd") == ""
  ex read_public("no-such-file.txt") == ""
  if is_inside(path) == False
    return ""
  var text = ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    text = fs.read(path) else ""
  text
